live_verification_notes: All 9 model names live-verified 2026-08-14 via 'block contact jmodel assign ?' on 3DEC 9.7.47: bilinear-mohr, cyjm, elastic, mohr, nonlinear, power, ratestate, softening-mohr, velocity-weakening.
A model name is also accepted directly at the 'block contact jmodel' first slot as a shortcut for 'assign'.
Subcontacts must exist before assignment (block zone generate for deformable blocks, block contact generate-subcontacts for rigid blocks).

Property discovery trick: with a jmodel ASSIGNED, a wrong name in 'block contact property' error-enumerates the model's full property set. With NO jmodel assigned the same command accepts any name silently ('assigned to 0/N subcontacts') - probe only after assigning.
Python Subcontact.prop(name) accepts ANY name without error (returns a value even for nonexistent properties) - it cannot be used for membership testing; s.model() reads the assigned model name back.

Unlike FLAC zone cmodels, the live engine has NO read-only guard: state variables (kn-current, friction-current, plastic-strain, theta, ...) accept writes via 'block contact property' and hold the written value (verified with set/readback round-trips).
State round-trip verified per model on stiffness-normal (set 1.25e9 -> Subcontact.prop reads 1.25e9).
